method: Expected bubbles are PDF text tokens in a column or row that was checked on the margin render. A detection matches when the label, orientation, and bubble center agree within 55px. Intersections are true only when both crossing lines matched an expected bubble. Intersection recall is not the product of the two axes.
view_status: unknown on every audited sheet. View boxes in the index are title lines, not plan extents, so view_id stays null.
page_rotation: 0 on all nine audited sheets. Rotation 90 is covered by the display-coordinate unit test, not by these PDFs.

intersection_recall_policy: Hand recall is recorded only for Burrville, where every drawn crossing of a verified grid line was listed. Other sheets report intersection precision: a detected crossing is true when both lines matched an expected bubble. They do not report a cartesian recall.

line_metric_note: On this audit a confirmed grid is one label plus its line, so grid-line precision and recall equal label precision and recall. A missing bubble is a missing line. A confirmed label on the wrong orientation is a false line.

after_logical_axes.match_rule: same 55px label+orientation+center rule as the v6s audit
